arxiv-1608-07889.title: Hilbert space hypocoercivity for the Langevin dynamics revisited
arxiv-1608-07889.creator: Martin Grothaus, Patrik Stilgenbauer
arxiv-1608-07889.description: Abstract . We provide a complete elaboration of the L 2 L^{2} -Hilbert space hypocoercivity theorem for the degenerate Langevin dynamics via studying the longtime behavior of the strongly continuous contraction semigroup solving the associated Kolmogorov (backward) equation as an abstract Cauchy problem.

arxiv-2006-07516.title: Analyzing the Impact of Foursquare and Streetlight Data with Human Demographics on Future Crime Prediction
arxiv-2006-07516.creator: Fateha Khanam Bappee 1, Lucas May Petry 2, Amilcar Soares 3, Stan Matwin 1,4
arxiv-2006-07516.description: Abstract Finding the factors contributing to criminal activities and their consequences is essential to improve quantitative crime research. To respond to this concern, we examine an extensive set of features from different perspectives and explanations. Our study aims to build data-driven models for predicting future crime occurrences.

arxiv-2108-10560.title: Self-Supervised Graph Co-Training for Session-based Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; November 1–5, 2021; Virtual Event, QLD, Australia Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowl
arxiv-2108-10560.creator: Xin Xia, Hongzhi Yin, Junliang Yu, Yingxia Shao, Lizhen Cui
arxiv-2108-10560.description: Abstract . Session-based recommendation targets next-item prediction by exploiting user behaviors within a short time period. Compared with other recommendation paradigms, session-based recommendation suffers more from the problem of data sparsity due to the very limited short-term interactions. Self-supervised learning, which can discover ground-truth samples from the raw data, holds vast potentials to tackle this problem.

Although significant progress has been achieved by using pre-trained neural language models, substantial amounts of hallucinated content are found during the human evaluation.

arxiv-2205-01003.title: Chirality in 2d pAQFT
arxiv-2205-01003.creator: Sam Crawford, Kasia Rejzner, Benoît Vicedo
arxiv-2205-01003.description: Abstract In this article, which builds upon the work done in [ CRV21 ] , the chiral aspects of 2 dcft on globally hyperbolic Lorentzian manifolds are developed and explored within the perturbative algebraic quantum field theory ( p aqft ) framework.

arxiv-2305-05767.title: Deep Learning of Sea Surface Temperature Patterns to Identify Ocean Extremes
arxiv-2305-05767.creator: J. Xavier Prochaska, Peter C. Cornillon, David M. Reiman
arxiv-2305-05767.description: Abstract We perform an OOD ( OOD ) analysis of ∼ \sim 12,000,000 semi-independent 128x128 pixel 2 SST ( SST ) regions, which we define as cutouts, from all nighttime granules in the MODIS R2019 L2 public dataset to discover the most complex or extreme phenomena at the ocean surface.

arxiv-2307-13195.title: Ensembles of Hyperbolic PDEs: Stabilization by Backstepping
arxiv-2307-13195.creator: Valentin Alleaume, Miroslav Krstic
arxiv-2307-13195.description: Abstract For the quite extensively developed PDE backstepping methodology for coupled linear hyperbolic PDEs, we provide a generalization from finite collections of such PDEs, whose states at each location in space are vector-valued, to previously unstudied infinite (continuum) ensembles of such hyperbolic PDEs, whose states are function-valued.

arxiv-2403-14247.title: Hint of dark matter-dark energy interaction in the current cosmological data?
arxiv-2403-14247.creator: Vidhya Ganesan, Amlan Chakraborty, Tulip Ray, Subinoy Das, Arka Banerjee
arxiv-2403-14247.description: Abstract Many previous studies have explored models of dynamically interacting dark energy scenarios instead of a cosmological constant and cold dark matter. This work aims to offer a comprehensive investigation of the Yukawa-type interaction between dark energy and dark matter where dark matter mass is also a function of a dynamical scalar field value.

arxiv-2405-04855.title: Revisiting general dark matter-bound-electron interactions
arxiv-2405-04855.creator: Jin-Han Liang, Yi Liao, Xiao-Dong Ma, Hao-Lin Wang
arxiv-2405-04855.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jin-Han Liang, Yi Liao, Xiao-Dong Ma, Hao-Lin Wang. arxiv-2405-10872.description: Abstract We report the results of an extensive set of simulations exploring the sensitivity of the BlackCAT CubeSat to long-duration gamma-ray bursts (GRBs). BlackCAT is a NASA APRA-funded CubeSat mission for the detection and real-time sub-arcminute localization of high-redshift ( z ∼ > 3.5 z\mathrel{\hbox{\hbox to0.0pt{\hbox{\lower 4.0pt\hbox{$\sim$}}\hss}\hbox{$>$}}}3.5 ) GRBs.

arxiv-2511-08390.title: Some components of the moduli space of Koszul Artin-Schelter regular algebras of dimension four
arxiv-2511-08390.creator: Vishal Bhatoy, Colin Ingalls, Félix LaRoche, Ravali Nookala
arxiv-2511-08390.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vishal Bhatoy, Colin Ingalls, Félix LaRoche, Ravali Nookala. We compute the Hochschild cohomology and the Kodaira spencer map for known families of Koszul Artin-Schelter regular algebras of dimension four. We show that when the Kodaira Spencer map at a point is a surjection, the image of the family is a component of the moduli stack of such algebras, and when the Kodaira Spencer map is a bijection, the map to the moduli stack is generically finite.

pmc-11388227.title: Assessment of needle-based confocal laser endomicroscopy (nCLE) as a tool for real-time diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-11388227.creator: Joseph Seitlinger, Florent Stasiak, Arthur Streit, Christophe Wollbrett, Joelle Siat, Lucie Schnedecker, Guillaume Gauchotte, Stéphane Renaud
pmc-11388227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe widespread deployment of screening programs has increased the number of suspected pulmonary nodules diagnosed. The main objective of this retrospective study was to evaluate the concordance between needle-based confocal laser endomicroscopy (nCLE) image patterns and pathology reports.MethodsIn this retrospective study, we reviewed all cases of endobronchial navigational bronchoscopy (ENB) performed using the nCLE system as a guide for injecting a dye marker or for biopsy of a lung nodule.

pmc-11535328.description: Assessment of economic traits of germplasms, which are associated with genetic variation, is vital for mung improvement. Therefore, by wielding the randomized complete block design with 3 replications, a probe analysis using multiple trait stability indexing and analysis of variance with Duncan's test at p ≤ 0.05 is performed to compare the means of yield attributes.

pmc-11556910.title: Migrant Work and Kidney Health in Nepal
pmc-11556910.creator: Sanjib Kumar Sharma, Madan Kumar Upadhyaya
pmc-11556910.description: April 2023 poverty indicators, the unemployment rate in Nepal is 10.7%. Labor migration has been a common livelihood strategy for low-income households over the recent decades. Remittances from migrant laborers amounted to 24% of the country's gross domestic product.1 The mean age of migrant laborers is 29 years, with females making up 50% of migrants worldwide and 8.5% in Nepal.

pmc-11630252.title: Dieulafoy lesion with rare vascular complications: diagnostic and therapeutic approach
pmc-11630252.creator: Qusay Abdoh, Enas Samara, Alaa Zayed, Mohammed Khader, Iyad Maqboul, Mohammed A M Rashed
pmc-11630252.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dieulafoy lesions are a rare cause of gastrointestinal bleeding, characterized by an enlarged submucosal blood vessel that bleeds without visible abnormalities. The diagnosis is typically made via endoscopy, and treatment usually involves endoscopic therapy. This case involves a 46-year-old female who presented with upper gastrointestinal bleeding due to a Dieulafoy’s lesion, treated with band ligation and later embolization after the lesion was found to originate from the left phrenic artery.

pmc-12586909.title: Tomato Roots Exhibit Development‐Specific Responses to Bacterial‐Derived Peptides
pmc-12586909.creator: Rebecca Leuschen‐Kohl, Robyn Roberts, Danielle M Stevens, Ning Zhang, Silas Buchanan, Brooke Pilkey, Gitta Coaker, Anjali S Iyer‐Pascuzzi
pmc-12586909.description: To combat soilborne pathogens, roots activate pattern‐triggered immunity (PTI) through pattern‐recognition receptors (PRRs) that recognise microbe‐associated molecular patterns (MAMPs). Root PTI pathways can differ from their above‐ground counterparts and have been well‐characterised in the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana but are not well‐defined in crops.

pmc-12716832.title: Time Spent on Social Media Applications in Relation to Depressive Symptoms During Emerging Adulthood and the Mediating Role of Sleep Quality: Cross-Sectional Observational Study
pmc-12716832.creator: Qi Zou, Jiabi Qin, Lei Zhang, Wenhua Wang, Xiaoxiao Yuan, Tingting Wang, Yuan Peng, Ye Chen, Linfei Dou, Xinghua Yang, Xirennayi Abudurexiti, Mingyang Wu, Alicia Stone
pmc-12716832.description: BackgroundThe link between social media use and depressive symptoms remains bidirectional. Findings in this area are often compromised by methodological limitations related to measurement and sample size. As a result, it is challenging to assess dose-response relationships and potential causal pathways.

pmc-13088578.title: GPA33 forms a distinct diagnostic target class to Claudin 18.2 in oesophageal adenocarcinoma enabling the development of a novel GPA33 antibody-based detection platform
pmc-13088578.creator: Jack Brydon, Radovan Krejcir, Filip Zavadil-Kokas, Ashita Singh, Tomas Henek, Lenka Hernychova, Skye Coleman, Sofian Al Shboul, Vaclav Hrabal, Zuzana Kuncova, Marcos Yébenes Mayordomo, Łukasz Arcimowicz, Kathryn L Ball, Monikaben Padariya, Umesh Kalathiya, Borivoj Vojtesek, Ted Hupp, J R O’Neill
pmc-13088578.description: BackgroundOesophageal adenocarcinoma (OAC) is a cancer of high unmet clinical need. Because of tumour heterogeneity, it is likely that OAC will be stratified into several subtypes. Claudin 18.2 antibodies form emerging novel therapeutics in patients with a subtype of OAC. A large-scale proteogenomics screen in OAC identified glycoprotein A33 (GPA33) protein as a dominating cancer-specific target.

pmc-13222873.title: Microsurgical Resection and Posterior Stabilization of a Delayed Solitary Thoracic Vertebral Metastasis From a Malignant Triton Tumor: A Case Report
pmc-13222873.creator: Mars Abdaev, Yuliy Kubetsky, Evgeniy Loparev
pmc-13222873.description: Malignant triton tumor (MTT) is an aggressive variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST) characterized by rhabdomyoblastic differentiation and an unfavorable prognosis. Spinal metastases from this tumor are exceptionally uncommon, and management strategies remain unstandardized and largely based on anecdotal evidence.

pmc-13232014.title: METTL5 deficiency impairs osteogenesis through OSER1-dependent antioxidant regulation
pmc-13232014.creator: Kexin Lei, Qi Yin, Qiwen Li, Qian Wang, Zhong Zhang, Fei Xue, Ruoshi Xu, Xinyi Zhou, Lin Peng, Shoichiro Kokabu, Shuibin Lin, Quan Yuan
pmc-13232014.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Methyltransferase-like 5 (METTL5) is a methyltransferase responsible for rRNA N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification, mutations in which are associated with skeletal abnormalities and cognitive deficits. Despite METTL5’s clinical relevance, the molecular mechanisms underlying METTL5-related genetic disorders remain poorly understood. In this study, we demonstrated that Mettl5 KO led to reduced bone mass and smaller body size in mice and impaired the osteogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells.

pmc-13404848.creator: Laura Ihalainen, Mariagnese Barbera, Timo Törmäkangas, Petteri Hyvärinen, Tytti Willberg, Pia Linder, Alina Solomon, Aarno Dietz
pmc-13404848.description: IntroductionHearing aids (HAs) can alleviate hearing loss; however, HA rehabilitation is frequently hampered by delayed diagnosis, suboptimal fitting and lack of systematic follow-up. Although the association between hearing loss and cognitive decline has been identified, evidence from randomised controlled trials remains limited.
